given.note: Refused (A-J5.md: A5-13 gives money_before, card_saved, deposit_paid; S13-55: 'A message never says deposit paid, paid in full ... unless the record says it happened'): the yes to the Groom's package's $40 deposit answers paid_full in place of deposit_paid. A deposit's yes gives exactly its branch's keys (takeMoneyBefore.response). Put right, it gives money_before, card_saved and deposit_paid, as j5-deposit-yes-page.json.

yes.exactWords: Groom's package, Sat Nov 7 at 10:20am, $140. A $40 deposit is taken now, into Lee's Barbershop's own Stripe, and counts toward the price; the rest is paid at the shop. Your card stays saved for the $40 late-cancel or no-show fee, which Lee's Barbershop confirms first.
